entries.themeBrief: WhatIf Première leçon de vol plané : commencement fictif du même Spyro, âge et proportions Reignited inchangés, sans forme bébé ni évolution adulte.

limitations: Visible source-model continuity, anatomy, costume/equipment, theme and composition reviewed; hidden details, exact color values and perfect1:1 likeness remain uncertified.
notes: First-step What If practice hop of the same-age Spyro over a low stream, four limbs suspended in a compact horizontal glide. Two wings present: large near wing and partially occluded far orange membrane clearly confirmed by exact crop behind neck; no extra or detached wing. Complete horns, claws and tail within margins. No baby/elder transformation. New stone bridge, windmill and training grass ledge differ from aerial Nexus scene.

sourceLimitations: Official artwork is loaded from the publisher domain, independently of the previous project sprite. Store screenshots are publisher promotional screenshots, not fan renders.
New scene layouts are original coherent environments inspired by source motifs, not asserted as previously existing named rooms or exact game geometry.
CG02 is a documented quest-object adaptation of weaponSolo because Spyro uses intrinsic abilities. CG10 is a plain original service apron, not claimed an official costume.
CG12–15 are named noncanonical WhatIf alternatives. CG13 chooses female quadrupedal counterpart only, and CG15 chooses first gliding exercise at unchanged source age.
Pixel-art interpretation and lighting do not certify perfect1:1 resemblance; each native requires independent comparison.

preservedDrafts.reason: First native clips the right wing and flame; retained after one legitimate ImageGen framing correction.

observations: Atlas retains purple quadrupedal body, orange wings, gold horns/crest and segmented belly, so the broad identity is recognizable.
Pixel faces simplify the official broad rounded muzzle and eyebrow shape; iris detail is largely dark instead of the source violet iris.
Claws are commonly bright yellow/gold rather than pale ivory/gray source claws. Golden scale edges and tail-tip shape are simplified.
Several silhouettes stack the far legs/wings; wing and paw count cannot be certified from every tiny pose. No newly corrected atlas has been produced.
